title: Kiongozi: AI for the green digital transition
intro: Seven quick questions. There are no wrong answers before the talk: we only want to see what changes by the end.

questions.q: In this talk, what does the green digital transition mean?
options: Switching every government service to an app
Using digital tools, including AI, to help people understand and take part in building a low-carbon economy
questions.why: It is about people as much as technology: digital tools and AI help citizens understand green policy and have their say in it.

questions.q: You want the Kiongozi AI to answer a question in a public post. What do you do?
options: Wait for a moderator to answer
questions.why: Mention @kiongozi in a post and the AI replies in the thread, usually within seconds.

questions.q: When @kiongozi replies to a post, who can see the answer?
options: Everyone who can see the post, as a reply in the thread
Only the person who asked, in a private message
Nobody until an admin approves it
questions.why: The answer is a public reply under the post, so everyone following the conversation learns from it.

questions.q: A post tagging @kiongozi is written in Kiswahili. How does the AI reply?
options: In Kiswahili, the language of the post
With a link to a translation website
questions.why: The AI answers in the language the post is written in, Kiswahili or English.

questions.q: Which topics is the Kiongozi AI guide built to help with?
options: The Constitution, county devolution, civic rights and the green economy
questions.why: The guide is briefed on the Constitution of Kenya 2010, Vision 2030, devolution, public participation and the green economy and environmental policy.

questions.q: Which of these can you do on Kiongozi?
options: Post, follow people, and like, repost, reply to and bookmark posts
questions.why: Kiongozi is a social network: a feed, posts, likes, reposts, replies, bookmarks, profiles, follows and direct messages, with the AI guide built in.

questions.q: Why put an AI guide inside a social network, rather than only on a website?
options: So people get accurate answers on green and civic policy where they already talk, and everyone in the conversation learns
So the AI can make decisions for citizens
questions.why: Green policy only works when people understand it and take part. Answering inside the conversation reaches people where they already are.
